name: Can all types of skylight damage be repaired, or is replacement sometimes necessary?
description: Many damages can be repaired, but replacement is necessary for severe rot, shattered glass, or old, inefficient units.

mainEntity.name: Can all types of skylight damage be repaired, or is replacement sometimes necessary?

acceptedAnswer.text: While many types of skylight damage, such as flashing issues, minor cracks, or seal failures, can be repaired, replacement is sometimes the more practical or cost-effective solution. If the skylight frame is severely rotted, the glass is shattered, or the unit is older and inefficient, a full replacement may be recommended. When making this decision, consider the age of your current skylight and its energy efficiency; older units might be leaking heat or air conditioning, making replacement a better long-term investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Many damages can be repaired, but replacement is necessary for severe rot, shattered glass, or old, inefficient units.
